_about: The Flock Portfolio v0 (2026-10-25). One portfolio, the same for everyone, built from the research. Each sleeve maps a research view to one plain, liquid vehicle. scripts/build_portfolio.py turns conviction tiers into weights. Not investment advice.

regime_sleeve.name: Short-term Treasury bills
regime_sleeve.why: The Running Thesis gives better-than-even odds of a dip before December (58% chance of a SPY close at or below 740 first), a December Fed hike is priced in, and credit spreads are widening. Part of the model waits in T-bills, earning interest.
regime_sleeve.rule: Set by the Running Thesis: 15% while it gives 55% or better odds of a dip before its next horizon, 0% otherwise. When the dip arrives or the view changes, the T-bills move into the core and the change is logged.
regime_sleeve.line: Earn interest while waiting for a possible dip.

core.name: Whole US stock market
core.why: Most of the portfolio is simply the whole market: cheap, diversified, hard to get wrong. Everything else is a tilt on top.
core.line: The foundation: own a little of the whole market.
core.risk: It moves with the whole market, up and down. In a bad year it can fall 30% or more.
core.source: The foundation of the portfolio, not a separate research call.

sleeves.name: AI chips and equipment
sleeves.source: House view: AI Infrastructure (High) + Phase 1 to Phase 2 rotation (High)
sleeves.why: Companies are spending hundreds of billions a year on AI data centers; the suppliers get paid either way. Includes the memory makers (Memory super-cycle, Medium-High), so memory isn't counted twice.
sleeves.risk: AI spending is being punished on earnings right now (the 'capex crack'). Chips can fall 30-40% inside a bull run.
sleeves.line: The chips and tools powering the AI buildout.

sleeves.name: Alphabet
sleeves.why: A cash-rich leader in search, cloud and AI, held at half weight because it is one company.
sleeves.risk: A large share of its cloud backlog comes from a few big customers, and one company can always disappoint.
sleeves.line: Search, cloud and a big stake in AI.

sleeves.name: Gold
sleeves.source: House view: Hard Assets / Scarcity sleeve (High, Hedge)
sleeves.why: If the AI trade disappoints, gold tends not to move with it. It's insurance for the rest of the portfolio.
sleeves.risk: Gold earns no income and can go sideways for years.
sleeves.line: A cushion when markets get uneasy.

sleeves.name: Defense and space
sleeves.why: Record order backlogs and rising defense budgets.
sleeves.risk: Depends on government budgets; backlogs have started to dip at some of the biggest names.

sleeves.name: Nuclear and power
sleeves.source: House view: Nuclear / AI Power Stack (Medium)
sleeves.why: AI data centers need power around the clock; nuclear is the steady source the big tech companies are signing up for.
sleeves.risk: Nuclear projects run late and over budget; much of the hope is already in the price.
sleeves.line: AI data centers need power around the clock.

sleeves.name: Healthcare
sleeves.why: Weight-loss drugs, an ageing population and beaten-down prices in parts of the sector.
sleeves.risk: Drug-price politics can hit the whole sector at once.
sleeves.line: A balance to the tech-heavy holdings.

sleeves.name: Robots and automation
sleeves.why: AI is moving from screens into machines: factories, warehouses, cars.
sleeves.risk: Early: no pure-play humanoid robot company is listed yet, and the theme is already popular.
sleeves.line: Machines that bring AI into the physical world.

sleeves.name: Bitcoin fund
sleeves.source: House view: Crypto (Medium) + the Running Thesis crypto rungs
sleeves.why: A small, fixed slice of the most established crypto asset, through a regulated fund.
sleeves.risk: It can halve in months. Kept small on purpose.
sleeves.line: A small, measured piece of a volatile asset.

sleeves.name: software
sleeves.why: Not held: AI agents let companies build what they used to buy.

sleeves.name: oil
sleeves.source: House view: Energy / Oil (avoid direct longs)
sleeves.why: Not held: the research avoids betting directly on oil.

sleeves.name: Quantum computing
sleeves.why: On the watch list, not held yet.

sleeves.why: On the watch list, not held yet.
